clue.text: After drink, extremely lazy and fat

indicators.note: the letters from lazy come after the drink in the answer

parts.note: port is a fortified wine, a drink

indicators.note: extremely means at the extremes, so only the first and last letters of lazy are kept

explanation.surface: Someone who drinks and lazes about ends up overweight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely' keeps L and Y, the first and last letters of 'lazy'.
explanation.definitionFit: Portly is a polite synonym for stout or plump in build.

clue.text: Holder of the colours

parts.note: reads like a standard-bearer carrying a regiment's flags, but it means the board an artist mixes paints on

explanation.definitionFit: An artist's palette holds the paints, the colours, while painting.

clue.text: Teacher's pet doesn't play out

indicators.note: to play something out is to see it through to the end, so the pet's word stops before its last letter

parts.note: a rabbit is a common household pet

explanation.surface: The class favourite won't go outside at playtime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Teacher's pet' looks like one phrase, but it splits: 'Teacher' is the definition and ''s' is a link (is). 'doesn't play out' cuts the final T from RABBIT.
explanation.definitionFit: A rabbi is a Jewish religious teacher, the word itself meaning 'my master'.

clue.text: Turn gas up in a way to make pasta

indicators.note: up in means placed within, so the turned word sits inside the word for a way in this down entry

parts.note: a lane is a narrow way or road

indicators.note: turn means flip over, so the word gas is read backwards, upwards in a down clue

explanation.surface: Instructions for raising the heat on the hob while cooking pasta.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turn gas up' looks like a cooking instruction; 'Turn' reverses the word, and 'up in' puts the result inside the word for a way.
explanation.definitionFit: Lasagne is a flat sheet pasta, and the baked layered dish made from it.

clue.text: Strip joints opening tonight

parts.note: a joint and a dive are both slang for a seedy bar or club

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter, here taken from tonight

explanation.surface: A notice that a striptease club is opening its doors this evening.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strip joints' reads as one phrase but splits into definition and wordplay; 'opening' takes T, the first letter of 'tonight'.
explanation.definitionFit: To divest is to strip someone of something, such as clothing or possessions.

clue.text: Mean, though popular, minister

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
to minister to someone is to tend them, look after them

explanation.walkthrough: 'Mean' and 'minister' both look like nouns or adjectives; 'minister' is the verb 'to tend', and 'Mean' is the verb 'to have in mind'.
explanation.definitionFit: To mean to do something is to intend it, a straightforward verb synonym.

clue.text: Rock plant highly sought after

parts.note: describes a much-prized flower growing on rocks, highly in the literal sense of high up in the Alps

explanation.definitionFit: The edelweiss is an alpine flower of high rocky slopes, famously coveted by climbers.

clue.text: Change course when vessel's caught in the swell

indicators.note: the vessel is held inside the word for a swell

parts.note: a swell and a toff are both old slang for a smartly dressed upper-class man
an urn is a vessel; the 's stands for is

explanation.surface: A sailor alters heading when the boat is gripped by a heaving sea.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface makes 'swell' the sea; it is a toff, a posh gent.
explanation.definitionFit: To turn off is to leave one road or route for another, changing course.

clue.text: Upset, if miler's speed remains unwavering

indicators.note: upset means knocked over or disturbed, so the letters are reordered

parts.note: here the possessive's S counts as a letter of the fodder

explanation.surface: A middle-distance runner's pace stays steady even when something upsets it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Upset' rearranges IF MILERS SPEED, the S of 'miler's' included.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin motto means always faithful, so staying constant and loyal, the US Marines' motto.

clue.text: Union strike

definitions.meaning: a society or association of members
to hit, as with a cudgel

explanation.definitionFit: A club is an association of members, and to club is to beat with a stick.

clue.text: The tears we shed for a loved one

indicators.note: shed suggests things cast off and scattered, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written as the letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: Two people weeping for someone dear to them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shed' reads as crying tears, but it rearranges THE TEARS WE.
explanation.definitionFit: A sweetheart is a darling, the person one loves.

clue.text: One of four on the fiddle

definitions.text: One of four on the fiddle

parts.words: One of four on the fiddle
parts.note: sounds like one of a gang of crooks working a scam, but means a part of a violin, which has four

explanation.definitionFit: A violin is strung with four strings, G, D, A and E.

clue.text: Long timber required for film studio

parts.note: to long for is to pine
timber is wood

explanation.surface: A big log is needed at the film set.
explanation.walkthrough: PINEWOOD Studios is a famous British film studio near London.
explanation.definitionFit: Pinewood is a well-known studio complex where many British films are made.

clue.text: When women propose to break with tradition

definitions.text: When women propose to break with tradition

parts.words: When women propose to break with tradition
parts.note: by old custom a woman may propose marriage on 29 February, a break from the usual man-asks convention

explanation.definitionFit: The custom lets women propose on the extra day of these four-yearly calendar years.

clue.text: Completed the course and got dead drunk

definitions.meaning: graduated from training, as from a military academy

explanation.definitionFit: Cadets graduate on parade, while a drinker can collapse unconscious.

clue.text: A number, if loud, irritate

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
f, forte, is the musical marking for loud

explanation.surface: A figure that is noisy might annoy.
explanation.definitionFit: To miff is to annoy or put out, a mainly British informal verb.

clue.text: Argument in cabinet

definitions.meaning: a set of reasons put for a position

explanation.definitionFit: A case is a reasoned argument, and also a cabinet for displays.

clue.text: Make a striking contribution to the conversation?

definitions.text: Make a striking contribution to the conversation?

parts.words: Make a striking contribution to the conversation?
parts.note: striking suggests impressive, but reads as the striking of a bell or clock joining in

explanation.definitionFit: To interject in a talk is to join with a remark, like bells sounding.

clue.text: Fielder makes initial mistake

parts.note: the initial one is the first
a slip is a small mistake

explanation.surface: A cricketer makes an early error.
explanation.walkthrough: FIRST SLIP is a cricket fielding position beside the wicketkeeper, catching edges.
explanation.definitionFit: First slip is a fielding position in cricket, and the player stationed there.

clue.text: Radar equipment for the surveyor

definitions.meaning: a device that sweeps an area electronically
a person who looks over or examines

explanation.definitionFit: A scanner is a radar aerial, and literally one who scans or surveys.

clue.text: Lack of action, but in time it turns up

annotationWithheld.why: Lack of action, but in time it turns up (7): INERTIA is IN + ER(TI)A, so 'in' must give IN and also signal TI going into ERA; one word doing two jobs
annotationWithheld.clue: Lack of action, but in time it turns up

clue.text: Notice to cut out and show

indicators.note: the word for cut lies outside the notice, around it

parts.note: to pare is to cut or trim
an ad, advertisement, is a notice

explanation.surface: An instruction to clip an advert and display it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut out' looks like scissors work; here 'out' means the word for cut goes around the notice, while the surface suggests clipping an advert.
explanation.definitionFit: A parade is a show or display, as in making a parade of something.

clue.text: Dog's very good about being put on new lead

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, written AI
re means about or concerning

indicators.note: new means remade, so the letters of lead are rearranged

explanation.surface: A fine dog is being fitted with a fresh leash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dog's' gives the definition and a link (is). 'new' rearranges LEAD to DALE; AI is A1, first-rate.
explanation.definitionFit: The Airedale is a large terrier breed from Yorkshire.

clue.text: Loved seeing a cheat blushing

parts.note: to do someone is slang for cheating them
red describes a blushing face

explanation.surface: A lover sees a deceiver turn red-faced.
explanation.definitionFit: Adored means loved deeply, a past-tense verb synonym.

clue.text: Board has no alternative to the French and the Germans

parts.note: the opposite of no is yes, which in French is oui
the German for yes is ja

explanation.surface: A committee leaves no choice to the French and Germans.
explanation.walkthrough: The board's name joins the French and German words for yes.
explanation.definitionFit: A ouija board is a lettered board used at seances.

clue.text: Military force calling for withdrawal

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
a vocation is a calling to a career

explanation.surface: An army unit summoned to pull back.
explanation.definitionFit: Revocation is the withdrawal or cancelling of a decree, licence or offer.

clue.text: I love getting a thankyou letter

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, shaped like O
ta is British informal for thank you

explanation.surface: Someone delighted to receive a thank-you note.
explanation.definitionFit: Iota is a letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Head girl is a macebearer

parts.note: nut is slang for the head
Meg is a girl's name

explanation.surface: The head girl has been made the school's ceremonial mace carrier.
explanation.walkthrough: A macebearer is usually an official, but mace is also the spice from the nutmeg's husk.
explanation.definitionFit: The nutmeg tree's seed covering yields the spice mace, so it bears mace.

clue.text: In time deserter will make mistakes

indicators.note: the deserter is placed in the word for time

parts.note: an era is a period of time
a rat is one who deserts, like rats leaving a sinking ship

explanation.surface: A runaway soldier will err sooner or later.
explanation.definitionFit: Errata are listed errors in a printed book, the Latin plural for mistakes.
